description: Read the public Connecty status page at <slug>.connecty.nl: each website's URL, latest status (up, down, unknown or pending), when it was last checked (UTC) and its 7-day uptime (share of successful daily checks). Sites are checked once a day at 08:00 UTC, so this is not live. Use slug "demo" for sample data.

slug.description: The page name: the part before .connecty.nl, e.g. "acme" for acme.connecty.nl. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

name: get_status_page
title: Get a public status page
